{{Top|leg}}
A '''blowtorch''' was an industrial tool that produced heat. Common blowtorches were fuelled by [[acetylene]], while more advanced models ran on [[hydrocarbon]] fuels. Blowtorches were often fitted on [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and could be used as an improvised weapon.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> The [[11-17-series mining droid]] was equipped with a blowtorch mounted on a telescoping arm. The blowtorch was used by the droid to burn organic debris, or soften up a target area prior to blasting it with its top-mounted [[plasma jet]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
